description: This file defines a React functional component 'RoleCard' that renders a job role card with interactive UI behavior such as hover effects, selection, and animated transitions. It also includes a 'SkeletonCard' component for loading placeholders. The component utilizes React hooks, external icon components, and utility functions for class name management.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React functional component that displays a role card with animations, hover effects, and selection state.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: React component providing a placeholder skeleton UI matching 'RoleCard' for loading states.
